Hi Guilherme,
There was an issue with KF214, therefore the dispenser outputs were out of service. The problem was resolved by replacing KF214. You may also review the attached report.
At the moment, I do not observe any issues at the station; charging is ongoing on both sockets.
However, a more detailed analysis would be beneficial.
BR,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478545-DC/Si-D/TR- [Y2 / RN 313405951028] Repeated Error on Charger CRM:00263000460
additional_info.body:
Hi Fosco,
In the initially opened ticket, the dispenser outlets were out of service. During the site visit, it was identified that KF214 had failed, and was replaced on February 11, which resolved the issue.
In the second ticket, it was reported that the same outlets had gone into fault again. When I monitored the unit during the day, I did not observe any issues.
We may check why the dispenser outlets went into fault on February 16. We can verify whether it was a momentary issue or if it was triggered by another factor.
If no issue is identified, I think we can close the ticket.
BR,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478545-DC/Si-D/TR- [Y2 / RN 313405951028] Repeated Error on Charger CRM:00263000460
additional_info.body:
Hello Mert,
I took time to analyze the events on 16.02.2026, as you suggested.
On that day, I saw that the outlets of dispenser went OoO twice:
One time at
2026-02-16, 11:36:11
when a soft reboot was triggered
The second time at
2026-02-16, 13:07:32
, as the charger failed to group all converter groups while exiting the power saving mode. At
2026-02-16, 13:10:05,
the charger performed a new converter grouping, and this time all converter groups were allocated correctly, and DC3 and DC4 went again available. DC3 and DC4 went OoO just for few minutes.
After my analysis, I do not see any particular issue on DC3 and DC4.
If you agree, I would proceed to close this ticket and open a new one if in the future the issue appears again.
Looking forward  to hearing feedback form you soon!
With kind regards,
